title: Maximum Number of Vowels in a Substring of Given Length

constraints.impact: Counting the vowels of every substring from scratch is O(n·k), up to about 10¹⁰ steps when k is near n/2: too slow. You need O(n).

constraints.text: s consists of lowercase English letters
constraints.meaning: Only 'a' to 'z'. The vowels are 'a', 'e', 'i', 'o' and 'u'.
constraints.impact: No upper case to handle. A letter is a vowel when it equals one of five letters, so the check is constant time.

constraints.meaning: The window length k is at least 1 and never longer than s.
constraints.impact: There is always at least one full window. The answer is between 0 and k.

bruteForce.summary: for every start i, count the vowels in s[i..i+k-1] from scratch and keep the largest count. O(n·k) time, which is too slow when n = 10⁵ and k is large.
